project.name: Ferreira house, 41 Tallowwood Avenue
project.summary: A single-storey 55 m2 rear kitchen, living and dining addition to a 140 m2 brick house built in 1958, with the bathroom and laundry redone and two loadbearing walls removed, on a 557 m2 R2 lot in Concord, within the Tallowwood Estate Heritage Conservation Area. DA to the City of Canada Bay, owners move out, architect-led tender to builders under an HIA lump-sum contract.
